# Rawcoderz brand asset

`rawcoderz-logo.png` is the original, unmodified PNG used by the header on https://rawcoderz.com/.

Source: https://rawcoderz.com/images/fav.png
Retrieved: 14 October 2026, at the site owner's request.

The header image is paired with the Rawcoderz name, as on the source site. The dark shell uses the source site's navy #05070D and strawberry-red #E63946 as its branding reference. No logo recolouring or raster editing has been applied.
